gwt.given: data is a 16-byte span of all-zero bytes with position already advanced to 1 (so only 15 bytes remain ahead of the cursor), and valueType = typeof(decimal)
gwt.when: TryConvertFromBytes(ref data, ref position, typeof(decimal), out result) is called
gwt.then: the data.Length >= 16 check passes against the full 16-byte span rather than the 15 bytes remaining from position 1, so the read is attempted; the first three BitConverter.ToInt32 reads (at offsets 1, 5 and 9) each still have at least 4 bytes ahead and succeed, but the fourth read at offset 13 has only 3 bytes remaining in the span and BitConverter.ToInt32 throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException -- TryConvertFromBytes does not return false and position is never advanced
